title: Streamlined login & onboarding, live Gemini thoughts, and inline Markdown images
highlights: Streamlined /login and first-run onboarding now present a compact starter list (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, API key, Auto Import) with paste-any-key auto-detection, masking, and collapsible OAuth/device progress cards.
Active turns now wait for network recovery and automatically resume after disconnects instead of failing mid-response.
Local Markdown images now render inline in the TUI via Kitty and Sixel graphics.
improvements: Gemini and Antigravity now stream live thought summaries over SSE with dynamic thinking budgets, and Antigravity supports reasoning-effort switching via sibling models.
One-command prerelease switching and live reload are now supported across the installer, CLI, and TUI.
Session picker search now indexes todo-plan intentions with prefix phrase matching, single-word intent ranking, and match-reason hints.
Per-provider context compaction threshold overrides can now be configured.
Gemini now supports native deferred tool loading via Interactions tool retrieval, and late MCP tools are announced as a compact one-line summary with on-demand schema lookup.
KV cache diagnostics now learn implicit-cache tail gaps and flag read regressions or outlier gaps.
Always-on Jarvis capture now suppresses itself during companion push-to-talk and defaults the Jev action-probability threshold to 0.5.
fixes: Prevented infinite client/server reload loops on Termux and duplicate installs.
Fixed automatic account failover routing for Antigravity quota 429 responses and advertised image input support on Antigravity.
Fixed auto-import credential detection, validation, and TUI activation issues.
Set Gemini 4 context fallback to 1M tokens and hid retired Gemini OAuth rows from the account router when no Cloud project is configured.
Normalized Jarvis user roles on soft-interrupt injections so final transcripts render cleanly.
